_description: Secret hygiene scaffold: pre-commit gitleaks, gitleaks allowlist, per-cloud docs (Vercel/Firebase/AWS/GCP/Azure APIM key-behind-proxy), and CI scan. Opt-in because it changes commit-time behavior.
_bootstrap: if ! command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1; then pip install --user --quiet pre-commit; fi
if [ -f .pre-commit-config.yaml ] && [ -d .git ]; then pre-commit install >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
